entries.title: New here? Genogram Genie and Life Map now teach you as you go
entries.summary: Open either tool and load a fictional example family or timeline to see what a finished one looks like — click around, explore, you can't break anything. Prefer to dive straight in? A three-step quick start checks itself off as you work, with small tips that appear right when they're useful. Both are always available under Help.

entries.title: Clearer account status and quicker sign-in
entries.summary: Your account page now reflects your subscription status accurately, including after a cancellation has run its course. And if you're already signed in, the sign-in page takes you straight to your dashboard.

entries.title: Brainspotting: smoother sessions, and your settings remembered
entries.summary: Brainspotting now remembers how you like to work — speed, color, sound, and mode carry over between sessions instead of resetting each time. Press the spacebar to pause mid-processing without reaching for the mouse, and the tool honors your system's reduced-motion setting. If a tab closes unexpectedly, your session is offered back to you on reopen, and the end-of-session screen is now a clearer Session Review.

entries.title: Life Map: send a target straight to EMDR
entries.summary: Click the EMDR button on any Life Map target and the bilateral stimulation screen opens with that target's name, negative cognition, and SUDS displayed at the top — nothing to remember, nothing to retype mid-session.

entries.title: Genogram: relationship lines that read like the textbook
entries.summary: Hostile is now a clear zigzag — the standard convention. New line types for Separated, Distant, and Volatile (close + hostile combined). Abuse lines can carry a small P, S, or E badge for physical, sexual, or emotional. Your genograms read at a glance, the way you were trained to read them.

entries.title: Genogram: a blank canvas every time, and nothing lost
entries.summary: The tool now always opens blank — no other client's family tree on screen when you open it in session. If a tab closes unexpectedly, you'll get a Keep / Discard prompt the next time you open the tool, so an accidental close doesn't cost you your work.

entries.title: Life Map: your work stays put
entries.summary: Clicking outside a target's details no longer discards unsaved edits, a bug that could erase a custom negative cognition is fixed, and if a tab closes before you export, the tool offers your work back when you return.

entries.title: Small things that feel better everywhere
entries.summary: Clearer first-open screens with one obvious next step. Escape closes any window. Gentler zoom — hold Cmd or Ctrl and scroll. Lots of little smoothing throughout the suite.

entries.title: Guided EMDR: session reports you can chart from
entries.summary: Download a plain-text summary of any guided session, ready to paste into your notes. All five protocols supported: Standard, Recent Event, Present Trigger, Flash-Forward, and Future Template.
